## Compare Hamburg apartment rents up to €1,600
Compare up to five agent-listed Hamburg rentals with at least two rooms and an asking rent of up to €1,600. Review the asking price, area and source listing.

[Preview the preset on Apify](https://apify.com/perceptive_city_af7/immowelt-scraper/examples/compare-hamburg-apartment-rents-under-1600-eur)

1. Open **Download Hamburg apartment rents** and select a **Header Auth** credential. Set its name to `Authorization` and its value to `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`.
2. Click **Execute Workflow** once. This starts one Actor run on your Apify account, capped at **$0.03** and **5 rows**.
3. Open the HTTP node’s **Output → Binary → data** and download the CSV. If the request times out, check [your Apify runs](https://console.apify.com/actors/runs) before starting a second run.
